purpose: Small development-only catalog for targeted Quackpot review starts.

qp16.pending-reveal.v1.limit: Historical generation was proven under its recorded recipe; the current Plan 16 loader intentionally rejects stale generated use. This catalog does not revalidate or relabel it.

qp16.starter-offer.v1.limit: One immutable mounted capture. Capture origin, current source closure, current loader identity, and current mounted behavior remain separate. Earlier branch browser records used the pre-archive-pin loader.

plan35.rent-paid-zero.v1.captureAction: Mounted starter decline from the exact Plan 16 starter capture, then capture the ordinary day-two rent view before Pay.
plan35.rent-paid-zero.v1.prePay: expense_due and activeBill are not expected until the real Pay action invokes billExpense('rent', 15.00).

plan35.rent-unpaid-escalation.v1.captureAction: Mounted starter purchase from the exact Plan 16 starter capture, then capture the ordinary day-two rent view before Pay.
plan35.rent-unpaid-escalation.v1.prePay: expense_due and activeBill are not expected until the real Pay action invokes billExpense('rent', 15.00).

plan35.finale-race-entry.v1.captureAction: Mounted Pay then the actual zero-cash Continue action; capture the ordinary day-three race-entry form before submit.
plan35.finale-race-entry.v1.selectionEvidence: Duck/stance selection is rendered UI state until form submission. No race_choice event or engine state write is expected at this boundary.

freshness.policy: Every new fixture records exact capture bytes, parent fixture identity, action route, original capture recipe/source identity, current loader identity, and full Plan16 production source closure. A mismatch blocks loading; no automatic rebinding.
freshness.onlySavedAtNormalization: No generated-reproduction claims are made for Plan35 captured checkpoints. If added later, only top-level savedAt may be excluded from strict semantic equality.
